premises.text: Connected vehicles can be remotely hacked, compromising critical controls
premises.evidence_span: suddenly your car is hacked. Critical control functions, such as steering, braking, and acceleration, is out of your hands

premises.text: Secure IoT is a patented multi-module software stack (encryption, auth, keys, firewall, OTA, big data) protecting connected vehicles
premises.evidence_span: Our core solution is Secure IoT. This is a software-based solution for protecting connected vehicles from hacker attacks. We have patents registered for this technology

premises.text: Cybersecurity-as-a-service is sold to fleet owners at a monthly per-vehicle fee with continuous updates via OEM and service-partner revenue share
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is based on a cybersecurity as a service offering that we offer to fleet owners. We charge $10 per vehicle per month

premises.text: Vehicle cybersecurity is a prerequisite for deploying autonomous, EV, and ride-sharing mobility paradigms
premises.evidence_span: Until we have cyber secure vehicles, we will never have autonomous drive
